evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we propose to take a unified view of all these tasks and introduce TAGPRIME to address relational structure extraction problems.

Many tasks in natural language processing require the extraction of relationship information for a given condition, such as event argument extraction, relation extraction, and task-oriented semantic parsing.
